167. One must not think that **forms** <note>The organizing principles or souls of things.</note> generate others like themselves within the **matter** itself; for generating is a property of bodies. Rather, it is the right and duty of the **form** to harmoniously move its own organs, and through them to prepare the **seminal matter** for generation. It must enclose within that matter a ray of light, or a secret spark of life, like a treasure. It must also imprint its own **specific character** upon that **vivifying Spirit** <note>The life-giving breath or essence.</note> hidden in the seed. During the work of generation, this spirit unfolds into a **Soul**—whether vegetative <note>The soul responsible for growth and nutrition in plants.</note> or animal <note>The soul responsible for sensation and movement.</note>—by means of a pulsing heat and at a fixed time. Thus, that which had been a secret and formal Spirit within the seed becomes the **Form** within the compound. In this way, what is hidden in the womb of **Nature** becomes manifest, and

<summary>This page explains that biological reproduction is the method by which God grants a type of immortality to species. It describes the "Form" as an active principle that imprints a "spark of life" and a specific character onto the seed, which eventually develops into a soul.</summary>
